text:
A hairdresser is using a hairdryer with a plastic casing. He notices that there is no wire attached
to the earth pin of the plug.
Why is an earth connection not needed?
A
Plastic is an insulator.
B
The hairdresser only touches the handle of the dryer.
C
The hairdryer uses a.c. so cannot give the hairdresser a shock.
D
Wet hands do not conduct electricity.

options.label: B
options.text: The hairdresser only touches the handle of the dryer.

options.label: C
options.text: The hairdryer uses a.c. so cannot give the hairdresser a shock.

options.label: D
options.text: Wet hands do not conduct electricity.
